snippet.title: Demiurge Sacrifice - New Launch Trailer
snippet.description: My game is finished and only needs some testing and fixing details! I had to delay a little the release but I will release it definitively during November :) This trailer is different to the other one because it features a more polished game both visually and technically. Hope you like it!
